iza_design: Quick sync on the sidebar IA tweaks want to capture a small decision set about breadcrumbs, deep links in emails/SSO, and canonical URLs. Short thread: thoughts on keeping both short and explicit paths? sam_pm: Users share links a lot (emails/github tickets) so canonical URLs should be human readable and stable. We also need the ability to show the old path landing gracefully for bookmarks. leo_frontend: technical approach: prefer one canonical path per resource, e.g. `/workspaces/:wid/deployments/:did` and support alias mappings for legacy routes. On first-load via alias we do history.replaceState -> canonical to avoid duplicate sessions. For email deep links we should prefer server-side rewrites where possible to speed up load. nora_router: edge rewrite manifest is the plan. We'll implement a small alias table at the CDN edge: alias -> canonical. We'll also add `X-Original-Path` and `X-Alias-Resolved` headers for a limited window so analytics can map behavior. Suggest retention: 10 days for original paths. maya_a11y: accessibility notes: breadcrumbs must expose the cluster explicitly: Workspace > Section > Item > Tab. If a user lands via alias, announce via `aria-live=polite`: "Now viewing Deployments in Workspace Beta". Also cluster headings should be semantic (h2) and include a skip-to-list anchor. For icon-only compact nav ensure each icon button has aria-label + visible focus outline. ria_research: ran a micro-session: participants felt lost when breadcrumb collapsed to single crumb. Showing the Section in the breadcrumb gave immediate orientation. Also preferred 'Deployments' (noun) vs 'Deploy' (verb). Recommend using nouns for cluster labels across locales. leo_frontend: pattern for URL shapes we discussed: ``` Canonical: /workspaces/:wid/sections/:sectionSlug/:resourceId Short: /workspaces/:wid/:resourceType/:id -> redirect/alias to canonical ``` Thoughts on `sections` segment? It makes breadcrumb mapping explicit but lengthens URLs. iza_design: pros of explicit `sections`: breadcrumbs map naturally, less guesswork for router. cons: noisy URLs. Alternative: reserve section slugs at top-level and ensure no collisions with resource slugs. Which is less risky? nora_router: I'd rather reserve section slugs (`deployments`, `models`, `observability`, `settings`) and validate at resource creation time to prevent collisions. Adding an explicit `sections` segment is safer but requires migration for existing direct links. We'll draft both options in RFC. maya_a11y: keyboard shortcuts: avoid single-letter global shortcuts due to international keyboards. Prefer chorded sequences like `mod+k` then letter, and make them discoverable in a help overlay. Ensure enabling/disabling shortcuts in user prefs. ria_research: also test compact mode: newbies struggled with icon-only nav. Recommend an onboarding tooltip the first time compact is active that shows label names and an expand CTA. sam_pm: metrics: create `nav_alias_resolved` event with hashed originalPath + canonicalPath and `alias_age` bucket. Keep raw originalPath only for 10 days then discard. Also track `migration_banner_shown` and `migration_banner_action`. deploy_bot: created RDW-9988 with subtasks: RDW-9988a alias-manifest-at-edge, RDW-9988b canonicalize-share-dialog, RDW-9988c a11y-snippets, RDW-9988d migration-banner-copy-test. leo_frontend: micro-implementation note: when landing via SSO with stray auth query params, run a small router normalize step after handshake to map legacy paths to canonical before rendering to avoid flash of old breadcrumb. Also keep a small migration banner cookie so we show it only once per user. iza_design: copy proposal for migration banner: "We've reorganized the sidebar to group related pages. Find your pages under the new sections — or click 'Show me' for a quick tour." Alternate concise: "Sidebar updated: pages moved into new sections." We'll A/B test tone. maya_a11y: small aria examples to include in the a11y snippet doc: ```
  1. Workspace
  2. Deployments
  3. webhook-2026
Now viewing Deployments in Workspace Alpha
``` Make sure the live region text is dynamic on alias-resolve. ria_research: next steps: I'll run 6 quick sessions validating compact onboarding, breadcrumb wording (nouns), and migration banner copy. leo_frontend: I'll prototype client-side alias-resolve + history.replaceState and a compact nav demo with accessible tooltips. nora_router: I'll draft the edge alias manifest RFC and reserved prefix list. iza_design: thanks team owners: Ria (research), Leo (frontend mock), Nora (edge manifest), Maya (a11y checklist), Sam (metrics + banner A/B). We reconvene after prototypes. :sparkles:
